newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weaker onshore on strong dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weaker onshore on strong dollar demand.

text.p: The Thai baht eased against the dollar early on Tuesday in the domestic market amid persistent commercial demand for the dollar, dealers said.
"There was bidding for the dollar on commercial demand. The market is quite active this morning," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was quoted at 29.05/29.15 to the dollar in early trade in onshore market compared with 28.90/29.00 late on Monday.
The Bank of Thailand on Tuesday set the weighted average interbank exchange rate 28.922 to the dollar against 28.578 on Monday.
